testing_centers.notes: Available at Certiport Authorized Testing Centers (primarily academic)

id_requirements: One valid, government-issued photo ID. Name on ID must match registration. For online: webcam required, room must be clear of people and materials.
exam_rules: No notes, books, or study materials. No phones or smartwatches. Whiteboard or scratch paper may be provided by testing center. Online: no dual monitors, no virtual machines, no headphones, must be alone in a closed room.
renewal_options: Microsoft certifications (Associate/Expert/Specialty) are renewed annually for free via a short renewal assessment on Microsoft Learn. Renewal assessment available 6 months before expiry. Fundamentals certifications do not expire.
target_audience: Candidates who automate Windows-based, browser-based, and terminal-based applications using a mix of automation approaches like UI, API, and database automations.
recommended_experience: Experience with the Windows desktop environment, scripting languages such as VBScript and JavaScript, .NET Framework for use in custom actions, and Microsoft Dataverse.

prerequisites.description: Experience with the Windows desktop environment, scripting languages such as VBScript and JavaScript, .NET Framework for use in custom actions, and Microsoft Dataverse.

retake_policy.notes: No waiting period for first retake if score >= 500 on failed attempt. If score < 500: 14-day waiting period before retake. Maximum 5 attempts per exam per year (365 days). Free retake voucher sometimes included in official instructor-led training.

editorial.meta_description: PL-500 is retired. Compare its historical blueprint with AB-100, see what transfers, and rebuild your plan around the current Microsoft exam.
editorial.overview: PL-500 was Microsoft's Microsoft Power Automate RPA Developer exam until its retirement on 2026-06-30. Its final published scope covered Design automations, Develop automations, Deploy and manage automations. This page preserves that dated outline for historical comparison and curriculum cleanup. It is not a schedulable exam, and its prices, delivery details, registration links, and practice calls to action must not be used for a new certification plan.
editorial.who_should_take: Nobody should start a new certification plan around PL-500. This page serves former candidates, credential holders, training teams removing stale material, and practitioners deciding whether prior preparation is reusable for AB-100. New candidates should verify the active Microsoft page and current dated study guide before booking.
skills_summary: Preserve practical experience from Design automations only where the current guide shows meaningful overlap
Preserve practical experience from Develop automations only where the current guide shows meaningful overlap
Preserve practical experience from Deploy and manage automations only where the current guide shows meaningful overlap
editorial.preparation_strategy: Do not rename an old PL-500 checklist or question bank as AB-100. Compare the two official guides objective by objective and classify each historical skill as transferable, changed, or absent. Use transferable experience as a diagnostic baseline, then rebuild labs and review around AB-100's current domain weights, products, role expectations, security controls, and operational tasks. Because Microsoft identifies AB-100 as the broader replacement path, review the skill map below before assuming equivalence.

domain_guidance.summary: Historically, Design automations required candidates to connect configuration choices with operational outcomes. The official outline included Design automations using Power Automate features and capabilities. Preserve hands-on understanding of those tasks where the successor comparison shows overlap, but do not treat this retired weighting or terminology as a current exam blueprint.
study_focus: Use the official historical objectives to document what design automations required
Mark each prior skill as transferable, changed, or absent in the current replacement guide
Rebuild practical exercises around current services, interfaces, governance, and role expectations

editorial.exam_day_guidance: PL-500 can no longer be scheduled. Use the active AB-100 certification page for current duration, languages, price, delivery, accommodations, and registration details, and verify them again immediately before booking.

methodology.summary: Cert Atlas compared Microsoft's final PL-500 study guide with the current AB-100 guide at the domain and objective level, then checked Microsoft's retirement list and transition announcement. OpenAI Codex assisted with extraction, normalization, comparison, and drafting. Claims were reviewed against the linked official sources; no exam stems, answers, choices, or explanations were used.

lifecycle.summary: Microsoft retired PL-500 and the Power Automate RPA Developer Associate certification on June 30, 2026. Microsoft places AB-100 in the broader replacement set, but the successor is an expert architecture credential rather than a like-for-like RPA developer exam.
migration_actions: Stop scheduling, selling, or presenting PL-500 as a current exam.
Compare completed PL-500 preparation with the current AB-100 guide; do not carry over obsolete weighting or mechanics.
Create a fresh AB-100 plan around its current domains and hands-on role expectations.
Remove or quarantine practice content that cannot be mapped to a current objective with source evidence.
Recheck Microsoft's dated AB-100 study guide before booking because role-based exams change over time.

skill_comparison.change: Process analysis transfers, while AB-100 broadens planning to AI readiness, value, responsible use, data, and organizational adoption.
Hands-on desktop and cloud flow building gives way to architecture across agents, copilots, models, integrations, and human oversight.
Operational discipline remains useful, but AB-100 adds evaluation, governance, security, monitoring, cost, and multi-agent lifecycle concerns.
